title: Majuli Raas Mahotsav 2026
description: Annual Vaishnavite cultural festival celebrating Krishna Leela through classical Sattriya drama, Mukha clay mask-acting, and all-night devotional Bhaona theatre across 65+ historic Sattras of Majuli island.
venue: Kamalabari, Auniati, Garamur & Dakhinpat Satra Grounds, Majuli
organizer: Majuli Raas Celebration Committee & Central Satra Mahasabha

title: Historic Howly Raas Mahotsav 2026
description: Celebrated since 1928, the Howly Raas Mahotsav in Barpeta district is one of Assam's largest and most magnificent 15-day community Raas festivals. Famous for over a hundred electrically animated clay dioramas depicting Lord Krishna's divine Leela, towering illuminated welcome gates, Thiya Naam recitals, Oja-Pali, and nightly theatrical bhaonas.
venue: Howly Raas Mandir & Mandir Grounds, Howly Chariali, Barpeta District
organizer: Howly Raas Mahotsav Celebration Committee

title: Assam International Book Fair & Literary Conclave
title_as: অসম আন্তঃৰাষ্ট্ৰীয় গ্ৰন্থমেলা আৰু সাহিত্য সন্মিলন
description: Northeast India's premier 14-day book fair bringing together over 150 publishing houses, Assamese and Bodo translation seminars, multilingual poetry recitals, and public literary interactions.
venue: Veterinary College Playground, Khanapara, Guwahati
organizer: Publication Board Assam & All Assam Publishers and Booksellers Association

title: Jonbeel Mela 2027 (Ancient Barter Fair)
description: A 500-year-old historic barter fair on the banks of water body Jonbeel where hill communities (Tiwa, Karbi, Khasi, Jaintia) exchange indigenous hill produce for chira, pitha, and dry fish without monetary currency.
venue: Dayang Belguri Field, near Jagiroad, Morigaon
organizer: Gova Deo Raja & Jonbeel Mela Development Committee

title: State Me-Dam-Me-Phi Ancestral Observance 2027
description: The sacred annual ancestral remembrance festival of the Tai-Ahom community. Ritual oblations, Phuralong prayers, and community cultural gatherings honoring forefathers for peace and prosperity across Assam.
venue: Rang Ghar Bakori & Historic Talatal Ghar Complex, Sivasagar
organizer: Directorate of Cultural Affairs, Assam & All Tai Ahom Council

title: 53rd Karbi Youth Festival (Taralangso)
description: Northeast India's largest and oldest ethnic cultural celebration, bringing together over 3,000 artists showcasing traditional Karbi music, Chong-Kedam dance, tribal handloom weaves, and bamboo architecture.
venue: Taralangso Cultural Complex, Diphu, Karbi Anglong
organizer: Karbi Cultural Society (KCS Diphu)

title: Central Ali-Aye-Ligang Spring Festival
description: The joyful pre-harvest agricultural celebration of the Mising community marking the start of Ahu paddy sowing. Features the ceremonial seed-sowing ritual, Gumrag folk dance, Oi-Nitom ballads, and ethnic cuisine.
venue: Murkongselek Tribal Cultural Field, Jonai, Dhemaji
organizer: Mising Mime Kebang & All Mising Cultural Council

title: Barpeta Satra Doul Utsav (Holi of the Sattras)
description: A 5-day historic Vaishnavite celebration founded by Mahapurusha Madhavadeva. Devotees chant soul-stirring Holi Geets, play with natural herbal phaku powders, and conduct the grand Suweri procession of Lord Doul Govinda.
venue: Sri Sri Barpeta Satra Compound, Barpeta
organizer: Sri Sri Barpeta Satra Management Committee

title: Guwahati Latasil State Rongali Bihu Sanmilan
description: Assam's historic open-air stage celebrating the onset of spring and the Assamese New Year. Showcases state-level Mukoli Bihu competitions, Dhulia drum & Pepa horn virtuosos, Bihu Kuwori pageantry, and traditional gamusa felicitations.
venue: Latasil Playground & Judges Field, Guwahati
organizer: Gauhati Bihu Sanmilan (Estd. 1952)

title: Bwisagu Spring Utsav & Baokhungri Festival
description: The spirited spring festival of the Bodo community honoring ancestral spirits and Bathou worship. Highlighted by the graceful Bagurumba butterfly dance, Sifung flute recitals, and the traditional Baokhungri hill-trekking expedition.
venue: Baokhungri Hill Premises & Harinaguri Cultural Ground, Kokrajhar
organizer: Bodoland Tourism & Kokrajhar Bwisagu Celebration Committee

title: Ambubachi Mahayoga & Cultural Conclave
description: Eastern India's most renowned spiritual gathering observing the annual fertility cycle of Mother Earth at Nilachal Hills. Features sacred bhajan-kirtan, Baul mystic melodies, and community pilgrim seva welcoming lakhs from all over India.
venue: Maa Kamakhya Devalaya Complex, Nilachal Hills, Guwahati
organizer: Kamakhya Bordeuri Samaj & Assam Tourism Development Corporation

title: Sualkuchi Golden Silk & Handloom Weaving Conclave
title_as: শুৱালকুছি সোণালী মুগা আৰু হস্ততাঁত সন্মিলন
description: A celebration of Assam's rich sericulture tradition in the 'Silk Village of Assam'. Features master weaver jacquard loom demonstrations, authentic GI-tagged Muga and Eri silk exhibitions, and fair-trade artisan pavilions.
venue: Gandhi Maidan & Sualkuchi Resham Udyog Ground, Sualkuchi
organizer: Sualkuchi Tat-Silpi Samiti & Assam Directorate of Handloom & Textiles

title: Nalbari Sri Sri Hari Mandir Raas Mahotsav
title_as: নলবাৰী শ্ৰীশ্ৰী হৰি মন্দিৰ ৰাস মহোৎসৱ
description: Lower Assam's celebrated 13-day cultural festival featuring over 100 life-sized clay idol tableaux depicting stories from the Srimad Bhagavata, illuminated ornamental gateways, and open-air Bhaona theatre.
venue: Sri Sri Hari Mandir Complex, Nalbari Town
organizer: Nalbari Raas Mahotsav Celebration Committee

title: Assam State Heritage Tea Festival & Golf Cup
title_as: অসম ৰাজ্যিক চাহ মহোৎসৱ আৰু ঐতিহ্য সমাৰোহ
description: Celebrating the birthplace of Assam tea with orthodox tea-tasting masterclasses, heritage bungalow tours, tea garden worker folk Jhumur dance, and competitive amateur golf at the historic Jorhat Gymkhana.
venue: Jorhat Gymkhana Club & Cinnamara Heritage Tea Estate, Jorhat
organizer: Assam Tourism Development Corporation & Tea Board of India

title: Dihing Patkai Rainforest & Heritage Festival
title_as: দিহিং পাটকাই বৰ্ষাৰণ্য আৰু ঐতিহ্য মহোৎসৱ
description: An eco-cultural confluence celebrating the 'Amazon of the East'. Features heritage excursions to the WWII historic Stilwell Road, Digboi Oil Centenary tours, Tai-Phake traditional village visits, and Patkai nature trail walks.
venue: Lekhapani & Ledo Festival Grounds, Tinsukia
organizer: Tinsukia District Administration & Forest Department

title: Judima Indigenous Gastronomy & Folk Festival
title_as: জুডিমা জনজাতীয় খাদ্য আৰু লোক-সাংস্কৃতিক মহোৎসৱ
description: Celebrates the GI-tagged traditional herbal rice brew 'Judima' of the Dimasa community. Features indigenous tribal culinary masterclasses, folk concerts, traditional sports, and panoramic views of Haflong hill amphitheatre.
venue: Gunjung Cultural Field, near Haflong, Dima Hasao
organizer: Youth Association for Development and Empowerment (YADEM)

title: Barak Valley Heritage & River Conclave
title_as: বৰাক উপত্যকা ঐতিহ্য আৰু নদী সন্মিলন
description: A cultural festival celebrating the historic Barak river basin. Features classical Dhrupad and Baul musical evenings, Sylheti folk drama, watermanship displays, and indigenous bamboo & cane craft exhibitions.
venue: Barak Riverfront & Gandhi Mela Grounds, Silchar, Cachar
organizer: Cachar District Administration & Barak Cultural Forum

title: Chandubi Lake Eco & Tribal Cultural Festival
title_as: চান্দডুবি বিল পৰিৱেশ আৰু জনজাতীয় মহোৎসৱ
description: An annual New Year lake-side gathering promoting environmental conservation and the rich folk heritage of the Rabha and Garo communities. Features boat rowing contests, ethnic food stalls, and traditional hand-woven textiles.
venue: Chandubi Lake Banks, Rajapara-Mirza, Kamrup
organizer: Chandubi Festival Celebration Committee

title: Brahmaputra Heritage Sandbar Cultural Conclave
title_as: ব্ৰহ্মপুত্ৰ ঐতিহ্য আৰু বালিমহীয়া সাংস্কৃতিক সমাৰোহ
description: Set on the golden sandbanks of the Brahmaputra overlooking historic Agnigarh hill. Celebrates classical Borgeet recitals, traditional boat racing, river ecology talks, and open-air folk theatre performances.
venue: Agnigarh & Bhomoraguri Sandbars, Tezpur, Sonitpur
organizer: Sonitpur Heritage Society & Tezpur Tourism Circle

title: Central Baiko Spring Festival of the Rabhas
description: The sacred spring festival celebrated by the Rabha community to worship the deity of wealth and crops. Witness traditional purifying fire-walking rituals, Nak-Chhungi dances, and prayers for abundant harvest.
venue: Dudhnoi Tribal Cultural Ground, Goalpara
organizer: All Rabha Cultural Council & Dudhnoi Community Committee

title: Rang Ghar Historic Bhogali Meji & Folk Games
title_as: ৰংঘৰ ঐতিহাসিক ভোগালী মেজি আৰু লোক-ক্ৰীড়া
description: A grand community Magh Bihu gathering at the historic Ahom royal amphitheatre. Features community Meji bonfire lighting, egg-fight and buffalo-fight folk sports exhibitions, and traditional pitha-laru culinary sharing.
venue: Rang Ghar Bakori, Joysagar, Sivasagar
organizer: Sivasagar District Cultural Society & Bihu Celebration Board
